result.rationale: absolutize_urls calls URI(url) with no rescue; the only guard in import is the regex /^https?\:\/\// which only checks the prefix, so a string like 'http://foo bar' passes the guard but URI() raises InvalidURIError, crashing PollFeed (which has retry: false). The mechanism is plausible, though edge-case-y since the regex filter catches most malformed input, so confidence is moderate.

adjudication.rationale: `TopicEmbed.import` only guards with `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, then calls `absolutize_urls(url, contents)`. In `absolutize_urls`, `uri = URI(url)` can raise `URI::InvalidURIError` for malformed-but-matching strings (e.g. bad escaping, incomplete URLs). There is no rescue in `import`, `PollFeed`, or `RetrieveTopic`, so this can crash the job/request path when such a URL is encountered.
